mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a backyard tiny home from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a backyard tiny home can vary based on several factors, including design complexity, local permitting review times, and site-specific conditions. Generally, the entire process, from initial design to final completion, can take anywhere from 6 to 12 months. This includes approximately 2-4 months for design and permitting and 3-8 months for construction. We work to streamline each phase and keep you informed of progress, aiming to deliver your tiny home efficiently while maintaining our high standards of quality.
